## Azure Deployment Environments  
  
<!--ae2f8c80-33a1-450b-9cd6-ee86ce0a6984_begin-->

#### Migrate from Azure Deployment Environments to Bicep  
  
Azure Deployment Environments is retiring. If you need environment provisioning and lifecycle management capabilities, transition to standard Azure infrastructure automation and infrastructure as code (IaC) solutions that best align with your existing development and governance practices.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions  

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Azure Deployment Environments retirement guide](/azure/deployment-environments/deployment-environments-retirement-guide)
